# Feature: Meshy avatar image-to-3d mode

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-09-18 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
Avatar “Mit KI erstellen” supports Meshy **Text-to-3D** (prompt → mesh) and **Image-to-3D** (image → mesh, optional texture_prompt for look only). UI never implies prompt+image jointly drive geometry.

## Preconditions
- Meshy BYOK configured; Character Editor, source meshy.
- User can pick mode Text | Bild.

## Happy Path
- [x] Mode **Text**: existing prompt flow (≥8 chars) → text-to-3d → job/poll/materialize.
- [x] Mode **Bild**: user uploads png/jpeg → Image-to-3D; optional texture prompt (look only) → job/poll/materialize.
- [x] Overlay/health/monotonic progress still work for both modes.
- [x] Copy clarifies: Bild steuert Form; Prompt (im Bild-Modus) nur Textur.

## Edge Cases
- [x] Bild-Modus without image: start disabled / 400.
- [x] Image too large / wrong type: rejected client + server.
- [x] Text mode without prompt: unchanged min-length gate.
- [x] Retry with existing provider_task_id resumes materialize (no re-upload required).
- [x] Poll uses generation_mode to hit text-to-3d vs image-to-3d status URL.

## Regression
- [x] Provider dropdown, health overlay, text-only path unchanged when mode=text.
- [x] Item image-to-3d adapter remains compatible (optional fields additive).

## Assumptions
- Image sent as data URI in start body (Meshy-supported); max ~4 MB file.
- Allowed reference formats: PNG, JPEG, WebP (`data:image/webp;base64,…`).
- pose_mode `a-pose` for avatar image-to-3d.
- Refine-with-texture-image deferred (out of scope).

## Security Coverage
- Image validated (type/size); SSRF N/A for data URI; Meshy host allowlist on GLB download unchanged.
- No Meshy key on client.
- Rate limit still applies on start.

## Composition Gate
- Start creates one job; poll materializes once; mode stored on job for correct poll hop.
- Proof: `.qa/runs/composition-gate-meshy-avatar-image-to-3d.md` — CLEAR

## Implementation Notes
- UI: `AvatarMeshyPanel` Text|Bild radiogroup; image file + optional texture prompt; no “reference image” on text mode.
- Domain: `MeshyAvatarGenerationMode`, image/texture validators, `resolveMeshyAvatarJobPrompt`.
- Edge: `generationMode` start path; `generation_mode` column (027); poll branches text vs image status.
- Client: `startMeshyAvatarJob({ mode, imageDataUri?, texturePrompt? })`.
- Check: `scripts/avatar-meshy-generation-check.mjs` covers both modes.
- Migration 027 applied on local `sagadrive-db`.
- GLB budget (028): soft 80MB → remesh @50k; store ≤100MB; download hard ≤200MB. Image-to-3d uses `should_remesh` at create; text+image both remesh via `/remesh` when still oversized.
- Local preview: `normalizeSafeUrl` accepts `http://localhost` / `127.0.0.1` signed storage URLs so Meshy GLBs load instead of the skinnie VRM fallback.
